title: dedx-erpa/dedx: An enhanced RPA-LDA model for ion stopping power (e-RPA/LDA)
description: dedx-erpa/dedx is an open-source implementation of the enhanced random-phase-approximation / local-density-approximation (e-RPA/LDA) model for the electronic stopping power of ions, valid from cold solids through warm dense matter to high-energy-density plasmas. Electronic stopping is computed from the finite-temperature RPA dielectric response in the local-density approximation over average-atom electron densities obtained with the Flexible Atomic Code (FAC), augmented by strong-collision, static local-field, electron-binding, and higher-order Barkas and Bloch corrections. The package also provides nuclear/ionic (elastic ion-ion) stopping and a cold-insulator band-gap correction, and outputs stopping powers and ranges for elements and compounds. This release accompanies T. A. Mehlhorn, M. F. Gu, and I. Golovkin, 'An Enhanced RPA-LDA Model for Ion Stopping Power from Cold Matter to High-Energy Density Plasmas: A Unified, Open-Source Framework,' Physics of Plasmas 33 (2026), doi:10.1063/5.0350289.
